              title: Display name
              description: The owner's display name, formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The owner's initials, formatted as upper-cased first letters

              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            registrationDate:
              title: Registration date

              type: string
              format: date

              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:

  id         INTEGER IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  first_name VARCHAR(30),
  last_name  VARCHAR_IGNORECASE(30),
  address    VARCHAR(255),
  city       VARCHAR(80),
  telephone  VARCHAR(20),

  customer_code VARCHAR(80),
  membership_tier VARCHAR(20),
